p.title: v59.99 the chat evidence filter deleted dated history and fixed definitions as unbound current figures
p.symptom: On a current-sensitive question the answer lost sentences such as "S&P 500은 11개 섹터로 구성됩니다", "2008년 금융위기 때 S&P 500은 약 57% 하락했습니다" and "금값은 지난 10년간 약 100% 올랐습니다"; only conditional or '보통/역사적으로' sentences survived.
p.root_cause: stripUnverifiedCurrentNumericSentences kept a sentence only when hasCurrentNumericContent was false or the sentence was a condition, so any number - a past year's move, a structural count - was treated as a current observation; the current-event rule exempted a calendar year but not a completed period such as '지난 10년간'.
p.fix: publication.js gains numericClaimKind(sentence, { today }) returning current, dated-past, fixed-fact, conditional or none; the numeric and current-event strippers remove only 'current'. A past calendar year or completed period without a current marker or a date in the last 60 days is dated-past; a count with a defining verb and no other magnitude is fixed-fact.
p.violated_rule: C16 / R687: only a number presented as a current observation must be bound to injected evidence; history and definitions are not current figures.
p.prevention: ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check v59.99 cases drive numericClaimKind, the event stripper, buildPublishableAnswerPlan and the fallback with kept history/structure sentences and removed unbound current readings.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check.mjs exit 0; the same gate against the previous publication.js fails 21 v59.99 checks, including the end-to-end plan case.

changelog: **Chat answers keep history and definitions ({P}):** on a current-sensitive question a dated past move or a fixed count is no longer deleted as an unbound current figure; only current readings still need evidence.
note: v59.99: numericClaimKind separates current readings from dated history and fixed facts
